_comment: Savings of one won city rain bet (design.md, City rain bets; flag rainChores). Kept apart from config/savings.json, whose catalogue is hashed in the backtest report. 'sourced' figures link their source; the rest are labelled 'typical estimate'.

car_rinse.assumption: a car wash skipped: about 40 min and 75 L of water, the lower end of a car wash (75 to 300 L)

bike_rinse.assumption: a bike rinse skipped: about 10 min and 20 L of water

terrace_rinse.assumption: a terrace and furniture hose-down skipped: about 15 min and 30 L of water

rain_fill.assumption: a rain barrel or bird bath top-up skipped: about 5 min and 20 L of tap water
